title: The Canonical Society Theorem
description:
Under specified source laws and complete responsibility contracts, we construct a family of inhabited canonical societies and prove that actor generation, root-law completeness, real exit, and all-depth regeneration can hold together. Actors arise from the sources and lineages of activity. Every complete installed institutional execution receives presentation, refusal retaining the bearer, action, or revision grounded in exact failure; actual writing occurs precisely in the last two cases. General exhaustiveness and inhabitation at one constitutional point are proved separately. At every natural-number depth, the same actual payment jointly generates six regeneration guarantees, and its actual successor is the entry to the next depth. More strongly, at every position in every cycle of the original type, each lawful payment carries the complete canonical contract into its actual target and generates there a new service or exit occurrence outside the entire old authority image. Even when instantaneous exit capacity remains one throughout, the frontier of fulfilled occurrences grows strictly with depth. Beyond every finite stage, actual revision and a paid successor birth also occur together. “Canonical” has its mathematical meaning: a standard construction generated from specified sources and rules, with its parts connected by compatibility relations.

These positive results and a family of impossibility results jointly characterize what institutions can accomplish. A worker's inability to exit may arise from missing payment incidence, an interrupted route, or captured continuation; all three yield zero capacity. Two actual sources with capacity one can likewise have, respectively, an inhabited and an empty complete capability portfolio. Accurate capability counts are therefore insufficient to identify failure sources, determine domain completeness, or select exact repair. In the constructed source families, this obstruction persists even when all domain-reachability readings are retained; two actual branches even share a root event, whole-ledger write-back, and next state while requiring different repairs. Conversely, the failure kind retained in the source suffices to recover canonical repair and its validity. The economic runs further separate legal recognition, settlement of old debt, and continuing payment. Original responsibility passes through revision to actual performance; for an exhausted source ledger, every same-source sequential target that adds no initial rows and increases no row's budget has zero progress budget at its first whole-ledger successor. Institutions must thus account for the bearer and consequences of every exercise of power, and supply actual sources for further continuation.

additional_descriptions.description:
本文在给定来源法与完整责任合同下，构造一族非空的典范社会，证明主体生成、根法完备、真实退出与全深度续生能够共同成立。主体由活动来源和谱系生成；制度的每次完整安装执行都取得呈现、保留承担者的拒绝、行动或有精确失败依据的修订，实际写入恰限于后两类。一般穷尽与同一宪制点的非空性分别得到证明。对每一自然数深度，同一次实际支付共同生成六项续生保证，其实际后继就是下一深度的入口。更强地，原类型任意周期中任意位置的每笔合规付款，都把完整典范合同带入真实目标，并在那里生成整个旧权威像之外的新服务或退出发生。即使瞬时退出容量始终为一，已兑现的发生前沿仍随深度严格增长；任意有限阶段之后，实际修法与有支付支持的后继出生还会共同出现。“典范”取数学中 canonical 的含义，指依给定来源与规则生成、由相容关系支撑的标准构造。

这组正向结果与一组不可能性结论共同刻画制度的力量。劳动者无法退出，可以源于支付关联缺失、通路中断或继续能力被捕获；三者都给出零容量。两个容量同为一的实际来源，也可以分别具有和缺失完整的生活能力组合。因此，准确的能力计数仍不足以识别失败来源、判断领域完整性或选择精确修复；在所构造的来源族中，即使保留全部领域可达读出，这一障碍仍然存在；两项实际分支甚至共享根事件、整账写回与下一状态，却要求不同修复。反过来，来源中的失败种类足以恢复规范修复及其有效性。经济运行还严格区分法律承认、旧债结清与继续付款：原责任须沿修订迁移到实际履行；对已耗尽源账的、入口无新行且逐行预算不增的全部同源顺序目标，其首次整账后继的进展预算均为零。制度由此既须为每次权力行使交代承担者和后果，也须为新的继续提供实际来源。

English and Chinese manuscripts and technical supplements, plus editable source. Formal proofs and original evidence: https://github.com/Sapientropic/H0mework/tree/2d6fbc96e33b7c4c3cfd91104fda74e3caeda045.
